_comment: One entry per converted line: how the line reads before (head text before its first key, and/or its diagnostic word)
and after (owner, message, diagnostic first, level, scope), key renames, repeated groups that become child lines
(split: a group starts at "start" and holds the following keys with "prefix"), the keys a child line repeats from its
parent (identifying), and the few lines with a special shape.  Read by tests/cases/fluid/free_surface_log_records.py
(both formats) and by the --map gate of the module-log comparator.  Values never change in a conversion.
